title: Azusawa Kohane — Emu Style? The Art Of Dancing!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: Emu Style? The Art Of Dancing!（4★）

rows.Line: Weekend Garage

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Phew...
Okay, that should be enough for today!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, good work.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You're gonna stick around, right?
How about your usual?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, please.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, An.
Can I get extra whipped cream, caramel sauce and nuts with mine?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Extra whipped cream, caramel sauce and nuts! You got it!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Geez, again?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: By the way, how has practice been going for... The Fan Festival, was it...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, that's been going great too!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Everyone from Wonderlands×Showtime gave me some really good dance tips.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, right. Isn't one of Toya's classmates in that troupe?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, her name's Nene Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Her included, it feels like we've been having so many strange encounters lately...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: From my classmate to Tsukasa's younger sister's childhood friend to actual idols.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, funny you should mention that. Minori's the first friend I ever made in high school too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, really?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And she ended up forming an idol group with my childhood friend?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Anyway, here's your order.
That should be everything, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, yeah. I mean, we all live in the same city, so it isn't that huge a coincidence.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Geez, way to take the fun out of it...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: By the way, An, have you had a chance to talk to Haruka recently?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Me? Hmm... We spoke once when she came here after she quit being an idol...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: She was here?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, a few times.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow...! A former A-list idol came here in private! This place is so amazing!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha! It's not like that. Haruka's just an old friend, you know?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Are you sure? I discovered this place by complete happenstance and started meeting all these new people.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Including you, An, and Shinonome and Aoyagi...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Not only that, but after I started singing, I got to become friends with this girl in my class who plays the bass!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, she's one of Ichika and Saki's childhood friends too.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see. Then, that means I must've met her during the Doll Festival...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'd love to introduce everyone to Shiho and Honami someday.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. So much has really happened.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hearing you sing, An, discovering Weekend Garage, you asking me to be your partner...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You even gave yourself a complete makeover as proof of your resolve.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, that really was a huge surprise.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I agree. Also, I never imagined the four of us joining together to form a team back then...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I know, right?!
We have Miku and the others to thank for that!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right. They showed us that we were all striving towards the same goal.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But being sent over to SEKAI without really knowing what was going on was pretty startling too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, that's right. You had a fight with your partner and were all alone...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Shut it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And now, we're going over there on a regular basis.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: More than that in your case. Haven't you been spending entire days off reading over there?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it's a very relaxing place.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Miku and the others are all so nice too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, are you including KAITO?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha... I'm sure he's a nice guy deep down, but yeah, he is a bit of a troublemaker...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Still, I genuinely believe that Weekend Garage is the reason behind me meeting all these wonderful people.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I dunno. We didn't exactly get off on the right foot...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, Kohane's trying to show her appreciation, so ease off...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You too...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Minori, Ichika, Kusanagi...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (We'll be performing at the Fan Festival together, so I'll do what I can to make the most of this opportunity.)
